description: This file defines the VariableViewModel class, which is a ViewModel component for managing variable properties in a graphing calculator application. It includes property change notifications, event handling for variable updates, and localization support.

classes.name: VariableViewModel
classes.description: A sealed ref class implementing INotifyPropertyChanged for variable data binding in the calculator app.

methods.name: VariableViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the variable view model with a name and variable reference.

methods.name: Min
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the minimum value of the variable.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the step value of the variable.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the maximum value of the variable.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the current value of the variable, with bounds checking and event triggering.

methods.name: VariableAutomationName
methods.description: Read-only property returning a localized automation name for the variable.
